scope: Read-only source review, independent local tests and checker evidence inspection; no native replay or solver qualification.

resolved_findings.issue: Partial SQLite merges cannot be trusted after interruption.
resolved_findings.resolution: Adopted closed database certification and atomic phase-directory publication. Interrupted cache builds are explicitly discarded and rebuilt; completed hashes and dependencies are revalidated.

resolved_findings.issue: Provider progress callback had the wrong signature.
resolved_findings.resolution: Uses the full original six-argument route callback and exercises the real reconciler in composed tests.

resolved_findings.issue: Cache wrapper replaced a failed backend verdict with passed=True.
resolved_findings.resolution: Requires backend passed=True plus exact stream/actual-read counts before certificate publication; failure cases are tested.

resolved_findings.issue: Equal missing features in both arms can pass equality alone.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact native row census is required before cache certification; equal missing feature fixtures fail before the pair gate.

resolved_findings.issue: Native checker override paths did not necessarily identify executed code.
resolved_findings.resolution: Native overrides are forbidden. Actual imported module paths and bytes are bound; frozen reader lookup is independently pinned.

resolved_findings.issue: Plain ValueError from native/accounting invariants did not create a semantic failure latch.
resolved_findings.resolution: Native semantic phases translate invariant failures to the shared failure type. Real accounting failure and failure-latch behavior are tested.

resolved_findings.issue: Signals before store ownership lacked durable diagnostics; child exit status was omitted.
resolved_findings.resolution: Pre-ownership termination emits bounded stderr JSON. Owned attempts retain exact signal and phase history. Actual Pool worker exit codes are retained after cleanup.

resolved_findings.issue: Qualified find_spec could execute an unexpected package initializer before validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: PathFinder validates the namespace without executing an initializer; fresh-process marker and reader-corruption tests establish rejection before code execution.

resolved_findings.issue: A custom binding file was not part of protected input paths.
resolved_findings.resolution: The alternate binding file is protected explicitly; exact-copy protection is tested.

resolved_findings.issue: Worker source attestations were executed but omitted from the bounded receipt.
resolved_findings.resolution: All worker proofs are validated for count, source, manifest and reader identity, then retained in the cache receipt.

resolved_findings.issue: Real saved route family keys contain suffix syntax not accepted by the initial extractor.
resolved_findings.resolution: The retained saved-capture probe first failed and then passed after preserving authenticated route key strings and parsing only the tuple-encoded families.

resolved_findings.issue: Export overhead was asserted more strongly than the evidence permits.
resolved_findings.resolution: Design/reporting describes removal of unnecessary materialization; it does not assign the old termination cause or claim target runtime sufficiency.

safety_conclusions: Progress counters and partial phase files have no qualification authority.
Completed state is hash-bound to exact source, executed checker, configuration, inputs and prerequisite certificates.
Direct sorted SQLite feature comparison and one bridge pair at a time preserve coverage and the actual inverse bridge checker without full feature/bridge exports.
Only explicit resume can reuse complete phases; semantic failure prevents ordinary resumption.
Existing source, sealed packages and native inputs are read-only; git diff reports no src changes.
native_deployment_preconditions: A new sealed native runner must reinstate allocation/CPU, per-process and aggregate 16 GiB memory guards.
A new native allocation needs explicit authorization and complete cumulative budget/history accounting; only 44 seconds of the original budget remains.
Native end-to-end semantic/provider/value/work/preservation qualification is still incomplete and requires independent review before any conditional commit.
Fixture timings do not establish a sufficient target-hardware time allowance.
limitations: No new target job, compiler, solver, performance measurement, automatic retry or budget extension was performed.
PhaseStore reservations are logical byte admission controls, not an operating-system filesystem quota. Native cache page allowances and bounded account writes must remain active.
The deleted databases from job55574 cannot be reconstructed by resume metadata; a future authorized replay must rebuild them once.
The process cannot record a signal after SIGKILL. Tests verify surviving complete certificates and avoid fabricating a signal event.
Changing checker/configuration/input bindings invalidates reusable state conservatively.
No solver performance benefit, cause of negative scaling or production promotion follows from these offline workflow tests.
